title: Jim Semivan told Ryan Bledsoe the family may be hybrids

tellings.quote: Semivan purportedly told him, "You know, we think you're hybrids. The reason you're having these experiences is because you may have more non-human DNA

plain: A man named Jim Semivan is said to have told Ryan Bledsoe that Bledsoe and his family may be hybrids, part human and part not: "we think you're hybrids," and the reason they keep having strange experiences "is because you may have more non-human DNA." The researcher Jason Simosa passes this on to Michels as something Semivan "purportedly" said to Bledsoe, so he is repeating it at second hand. If it were true, it would mean some people's encounters come from something in their own bloodline.
